title: User Experience Intro
description: Introduction to user experience design including user research, wireframing, user testing, and information architecture.

badge.name: UX Pioneer
badge.description: Awarded for completing User Experience Intro.

modules.title: Module 1: Foundations
modules.summary: Learn the essentials of module 1 for User Experience Intro.

lessons.title: Design Principles: User Experience Intro - Lesson 1

content.text: In this lesson you'll learn about Design Principles and how to apply it in real-world scenarios within the context of User Experience Intro.
Core Concept: Design Principles
This lesson covers the fundamentals of Design Principles. You'll learn practical techniques you can apply immediately in your user experience intro projects.

content.title: Pro Tip
content.text: Practice Design Principles with real examples before moving to the next lesson.

content.title: Common Mistake
content.text: Beginners often rush through Design Principles without mastering the fundamentals. Take your time and build a solid foundation.

content.question: What is the main goal of learning Design Principles in User Experience Intro?
content.explanation: The goal is to build a solid foundation in Design Principles that you can build on.

content.text: Apply it
Try applying Design Principles to a small project this week. Reflect on what worked and what needs more practice.

finalAssessment.title: UX Pioneer Assessment
finalAssessment.intro: Answer all 8 questions. Score 80% or higher to earn the UX Pioneer badge and certificate. You can retake the assessment if needed.

questions.question: What is the primary focus of User Experience Intro?
questions.explanation: User Experience Intro focuses on practical, usable skills.

questions.question: Which level is this course designed for?
questions.explanation: This course is designed for beginner learners.

questions.question: How many modules does this course have?
questions.explanation: The course is organized into 5 modules.

questions.question: What do you earn on completion?
questions.explanation: Completing the course and assessment earns a badge and certificate.

questions.question: Can you retake the final assessment?
questions.explanation: You can retake the assessment if you need to.

questions.question: Is practice recommended?
questions.explanation: Practice is essential to mastering any skill.

questions.question: What is included in each lesson?
questions.explanation: Lessons include content, examples, and knowledge checks.

questions.question: Who can take this course?
questions.explanation: Anyone interested in the topic can take this course.
